anchor.statement: Lemma 8.8. Suppose that the slow base satisfies (8.24), with the fixed λ > 0 and lower bound |a( η )| ≥ a 0 > 0. Let ( β , v, γ ) be a smooth divergence-free mean correction supported in the active shell, and keep the base and wave field w fixed. Form g r and (P, J θ , J z ) by Equations (8.3), (8.12) and (8.15). Apply Lemma 8.7 with these three defects as its targets, and realize the resulting γ d by (8.14). For the updated mean velocity ( β new , v new , γ new ) = ( β + ∆ β , v + ∆ v, γ + ∆ γ ),

correspondence.by: Christian Garry (drafted with Claude Code; second review by ChatGPT, checked)
correspondence.note: rankStage_gain_of_targets assumes the three current defects lie in the unweighted class of exponent H ≥ 9/10, the cumulative bounds v, γ ∈ M_{0.9}, β ∈ M_{1.9}, and base bounds only on the topological support of the rank potential, and concludes that the radial remainder lies in M_{H+9/10−2κ} and the recomputed defects in the unweighted class H+9/10−2κ, deriving the increment bounds itself. For the same rank stage, actualRadialError_eq_formula gives the explicit remainder (8.26) and debt_eq_remainders the recomputed defects (8.27).

∀ {P : Type} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup P] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ P] [FiniteDimensional ℝ P]
  {g : NavierStokes.VariableGaugeMean.GaugeData P} {r : NavierStokes.CorrectionState.RankData P} {U : Set P}
  {c : NavierStokes.CorrectionState.Context (NavierStokes.LocalRankDefect.Point P)}
  {u : NavierStokes.CorrectionState.State (NavierStokes.LocalRankDefect.Point P)},
  NavierStokes.LocalRankDefect.RankGeometry g r U c u →
    ∀ {a b : ℝ},
      0 < a →
        a < b →
          IsOpen U →
            (∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ x ∈ U, a ≤ r.length n x * r.inner) →
              (∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ x ∈ U, r.length n x * r.outer ≤ b) →
                ∀ (axial : P × NavierStokes.PressureStream.Plane),
                  NavierStokes.LocalRankDefect.LocalOperators U c.operators →
                    NavierStokes.MeanIncrementBounds.SmoothTriple (NavierStokes.LocalRankDefect.positiveDomain U)
                        c.base →
                      NavierStokes.LocalRankDefect.LocalTriple a b U u.mean →
                        (∀ (i j : Fin 3), NavierStokes.LocalRankDefect.LocalShell a b U (u.covariance i j)) →
                          NavierStokes.LocalRankDefect.IsSlowOn U c.base.angular →
                            NavierStokes.LocalRankDefect.IsSlowOn U c.base.axial →
                              ∀ (n : ℕ) {x : P},
                                x ∈ U →
                                  NavierStokes.CorrectionState.debt c
                                      (NavierStokes.VariableGaugeMean.rankStageState g r axial c u) n x =

                                      (NavierStokes.VariableGaugeMean.rankIncrementState g r axial c u) u.covariance n x
